module.name: Bedrock Smart-LLM IRSA
module.description: Creates the IAM role the app/bedrock-smartllm-backend ServiceAccount assumes via IRSA to call Bedrock (InvokeModel + Converse on 3 foundation models). Looks up the EKS cluster's OIDC provider by cluster name; trust policy uses StringEquals (no wildcard) on the SA subject claim.

optional.reason: The role's trust policy binds to the SA this module creates (default/bedrock-smartllm)
optional.provides: IAM role ARN consumed by the backend module's bedrock_role_arn input

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the EKS cluster hosting the bedrock-smartllm-backend pods. Auto-injected from the project's attached k8s cluster.

optional.name: aws_region
optional.description: AWS region (informational — foundation-model ARNs use `*` for region)

optional.name: role_name
optional.description: Name for the created IAM role

optional.name: sa_namespace
optional.description: Kubernetes namespace of the SA (must match backend module's namespace)

optional.name: sa_name
optional.description: Kubernetes ServiceAccount name (must match backend module's SA — currently hardcoded bedrock-smartllm)

optional.name: model_ids
optional.description: Bedrock foundation-model IDs the role can invoke

optional.name: tags
optional.description: Tags applied to the IAM role

key_outputs.name: role_arn
key_outputs.description: IAM role ARN for the backend module's bedrock_role_arn input

key_outputs.name: role_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the created IAM role

key_outputs.name: oidc_provider_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the EKS OIDC provider the role trusts

key_outputs.name: sa_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace the role is bound to (must match the backend module's SA namespace)

key_outputs.name: sa_name
key_outputs.description: SA name the role is bound to
